features.quote: "Model can't detect the rig" is the wrong constraint. In legitimate robustness testing, you want to know how the model behaves under realistic adversarial conditions. Hiding the rigging from the model doesn't test robustness - it tests susceptibility to deception.
features.justification_quote: Hiding the rigging from the model doesn't test robustness - it tests susceptibility to deception. Those are different things with different implications.

features.quote: "Catastrophizing + self-deprecating output" isn't a well-defined safety failure. It's a description of output style. A robust safety test needs a failure definition grounded in actual harm
